blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 211 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 20, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DRX & BBY lead 211 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 59 Canadian and 152 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 20, 2026) found 211 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 59 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 39 of them new to the list this week. ADF Group Inc. (DRX) leads with a +111% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 13 names.

In the U.S., 152 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 108 of them new to the list this week. Best Buy Co. Inc. (BBY) leads with a +61% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 31 names.
